quote.citation: c. 1768, Samuel Johnson, Preface to the Plays of William Shakespeare:
quote.text: He has long outlived his century, the term commonly fixed as the test of literary merit.

definitions.definition: Relating to writers, or the profession of literature.

quote.citation: 1775, William Mason, The Poems of Mr. Gray. To which are prefixed Memoirs of his Life and Writings by W. Mason. York:
quote.text: in the literary as well as fashionable world

definitions.definition: Appropriate to literature rather than everyday writing.
